description: This file implements the 'git replace' command in Git, providing functionalities such as listing, deleting, editing, grafting, and converting graft files for object replacements within a Git repository.

methods.name: show_reference
methods.description: Displays reference information based on the specified pattern and format, including short, medium, and long formats with object type details.

methods.name: list_replace_refs
methods.description: Lists all replace references matching a pattern in a specified format.

methods.name: for_each_replace_name
methods.description: Iterates over given object identifiers, applying a callback function to each replace reference.

methods.name: delete_replace_ref
methods.description: Deletes a replace reference by name.

methods.name: check_ref_valid
methods.description: Validates if a reference name is valid and does not already exist unless forced.

methods.name: replace_object_oid
methods.description: Replaces an object in the repository with a new object, updating the reference accordingly.

methods.name: replace_object
methods.description: Resolves object references and performs replacement.

methods.name: export_object
methods.description: Exports an object to a file, either raw or pretty-printed.

methods.name: import_object
methods.description: Imports an object from a file into the repository, handling different object types.

methods.name: edit_and_replace
methods.description: Allows editing an object via an external editor and replaces it in the repository.

methods.name: replace_parents
methods.description: Replaces the parent commits in a commit buffer.

methods.name: check_one_mergetag
methods.description: Checks if a mergetag in a commit matches expected tags.

methods.name: check_mergetags
methods.description: Validates mergetags in a commit against expected tags.

methods.name: create_graft
methods.description: Creates a graft (replacement) for a commit, modifying its parent commits.

methods.name: convert_graft_file
methods.description: Converts an existing graft file into replace references.

methods.name: cmd_replace
methods.description: Main function handling the 'git replace' command, dispatching subcommands based on options.
